# 5. Archetypes {#sec-archetypes}

The recurring resolutions — combinations of competing pressures settled at a particular scale zone and sharing position that keep reappearing across real projects. Archetypes are the **structure register**: what the two axes (scale × sharing–sparing) produce, paired with the [restorative functions](6-restorative-functions.qmd) that overlay them. We use *archetype* in its plain sense — a characteristic, recurring, transformable pattern, not an exhaustive set. (In New Urbanism's *Archetype → Prototype → Type → Stereotype* ladder these sit at the **Type** rung; we keep *archetype* as the register's plain-language label.)

Each archetype below states its *dominant* and *yielded* pressures; read across the [SCALE domains](6-restorative-functions.qmd#sec-fn-archetypes) (§6.5), those trade-offs become a characteristic footprint that distinguishes one archetype from another.

**Overstory Agrivoltaic** *(vineyard, orchard)*
[A2](1-the-scale-transect.qmd#sec-zones), occasionally [A3](1-the-scale-transect.qmd#sec-zones) · **[S1](2-the-sharingsparing-axis.qmd#sec-positions)** · *[structure-led](1-the-scale-transect.qmd#sec-siting-latitude)*
*Dominant pressures:* [agricultural continuity](3-design-pressures.qmd#sec-pressures), [social license](3-design-pressures.qmd#sec-pressures).
*Yielded:* [capital discipline](3-design-pressures.qmd#sec-pressures) (high clearance is expensive), [generation yield](3-design-pressures.qmd#sec-pressures) (row spacing serves the crop).
*Signature levers:* high clearance, possibly semitransparent modules, row geometry set by crop light requirements.

**Grazed Habitat Array**
[A4](1-the-scale-transect.qmd#sec-zones)–[A5](1-the-scale-transect.qmd#sec-zones) · **[S2](2-the-sharingsparing-axis.qmd#sec-positions)–[S3](2-the-sharingsparing-axis.qmd#sec-positions)** · *[management-led](1-the-scale-transect.qmd#sec-siting-latitude)*
*Dominant pressures:* generation yield, [operational simplicity](3-design-pressures.qmd#sec-pressures) — grazing approaches cost parity with mowing rather than beating it outright, its vegetation-management advantage back-loaded to the mature-project years once the establishment invoices are behind, with restorative benefit following.
*Yielded:* agricultural continuity in the strong sense (grazing is a service contract, not the farm's own operation).
*Signature levers:* contract-enterprise management regime, rotation logistics, fence-gate topology, water access.

**Buffer-Integrated Array** *(prairie strips)*
A3 · **S3** · *[siting-led](1-the-scale-transect.qmd#sec-siting-latitude)*
*Dominant pressures:* [restorative ambition](3-design-pressures.qmd#sec-pressures) with a specific service target (erosion, nutrient runoff), social license.
*Yielded:* some generation yield to buffer geometry.
*Signature levers:* placement logic along hydrologic features, ground-layer composition, conservation payment stacking.

**Marginal-Land Diversification Array**
A2–A3 · **[S4](2-the-sharingsparing-axis.qmd#sec-positions)** · *siting-led*
*Dominant pressures:* farm economic resilience, capital discipline.
*Yielded:* generation yield (marginal ground is rarely optimally shaped or oriented).
*Signature levers:* placement logic within field, ground layer determined by what marginal ground supports.

> **Note the kinship.** This archetype and the buffer-integrated one share an economic engine: prairie strips pay because they cost less than farming consistently low-yielding ground, which is the same partial-budget logic driving marginal-land solar siting. They differ mainly in whether the spared ground carries a designed ecological function or an energy function. Both are siting-led, and both depend on the A2–A3 latitude that makes choosing the ground possible at all — which is precisely why neither scales upward without changing into something else. Two archetypes, one insight, and a good illustration of what the pressure framing reveals that a template catalog hides.

Four more Types in current circulation:

**Vertical-Bifacial Cropland Array**
[A2](1-the-scale-transect.qmd#sec-zones)–[A4](1-the-scale-transect.qmd#sec-zones) · **[S1](2-the-sharingsparing-axis.qmd#sec-positions)** · *[structure-led](1-the-scale-transect.qmd#sec-siting-latitude)*
*Dominant pressures:* [agricultural continuity](3-design-pressures.qmd#sec-pressures), [generation yield](3-design-pressures.qmd#sec-pressures).
*Yielded:* [capital discipline](3-design-pressures.qmd#sec-pressures) (frameless glass–glass modules, more posts per watt), land-use density.
*Signature levers:* vertical east–west [module technology](4-general-terminology.qmd#term-module-technology), bifacial modules, wide (~8 m) row geometry set by machinery rather than crop light [@vaverkova2026]. The clean annual-arable S1 case that the overstory geometry misses.

**Community-Solar Pollinator Array**
[A3](1-the-scale-transect.qmd#sec-zones) · **[S3](2-the-sharingsparing-axis.qmd#sec-positions)** · *[management-led](1-the-scale-transect.qmd#sec-siting-latitude)*
*Dominant pressures:* [social license](3-design-pressures.qmd#sec-pressures), [restorative ambition](3-design-pressures.qmd#sec-pressures) with a pollinator/biodiversity service target, [offtake conformity](3-design-pressures.qmd#sec-pressures) (community-solar subscribers plus pollinator/habitat certification as the buying-side channel).
*Yielded:* some [operational simplicity](3-design-pressures.qmd#sec-pressures) during the multi-year establishment.
*Signature levers:* whole-site native [ground-layer](4-general-terminology.qmd#term-ground-layer) composition, seeded establishment, mowing/grazing timing set for bloom.

**Native-Grassland Utility Array**
[A4](1-the-scale-transect.qmd#sec-zones)–[A5](1-the-scale-transect.qmd#sec-zones) · **[S3](2-the-sharingsparing-axis.qmd#sec-positions)** · *[management-led](1-the-scale-transect.qmd#sec-siting-latitude)*
*Dominant pressures:* generation yield, restorative ambition (grassland restoration [@walston2025]).
*Yielded:* agricultural continuity.
*Signature levers:* native seed mix, deferred/rotational mowing, soil-carbon establishment [@krasner2025]. The characteristic large-scale [convergence case](2-the-sharingsparing-axis.qmd#sec-wedge) (§2.2).

**Brightfield / Reclaimed-Land Array**
[A3](1-the-scale-transect.qmd#sec-zones)–[A5](1-the-scale-transect.qmd#sec-zones) · **[S4](2-the-sharingsparing-axis.qmd#sec-positions)** · *[siting-led](1-the-scale-transect.qmd#sec-siting-latitude)*
*Dominant pressures:* capital discipline (uniformly low-value ground), social license (reuse of degraded land).
*Yielded:* some generation yield (sites are constrained).
*Signature levers:* placement on reclaimed mine land, landfills, and brownfields; remediation constraints on foundations and ground layer. The standing [S4-at-A5 exception](2-the-sharingsparing-axis.qmd#sec-wedge) (§2.2).

### Associated Terminology

Defined here (this section is their collection point):

**Archetype** — A way the [design pressures](3-design-pressures.qmd#sec-pressures-ch) have been resolved at a particular scale zone and sharing position; the four templates above are archetypes, not the object of the lexicon.

**Type** — Following New Urbanism's Archetype → Prototype → Type → Stereotype progression, the archetypes are Types: real, transformable instances, not an exhaustive set.
